description: This file defines the 'WorkShift' entity class for the OrangeHRM project, representing a work shift with properties such as ID, name, hours per day, start time, and end time, including getter and setter methods. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to a database table.

classes.name: WorkShift
classes.description: Entity class mapped to 'ohrm_work_shift' table, representing a work shift with properties for managing shift details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the work shift.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the work shift.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the work shift.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the work shift.

methods.name: getHoursPerDay
methods.description: Returns the number of hours per day for the shift.

methods.name: setHoursPerDay
methods.description: Sets the number of hours per day for the shift.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the shift.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the shift.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the shift.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the shift.
